source_description: 'A Call to Prayer & Lament' — a December 2025 open letter by ethnic-minority PCA pastors and leaders, spearheaded by Irwyn Ince (former Director of PCA Mission to North America, who resigned in September 2025 after appearing at a 'blacks-only' church event) and Duke Kwon (TE, GraceDC Meridian Hill / GraceDC network, Washington DC). The document laments four things: (1) a 'schismatic culture' / culture of suspicion and gracelessness; (2) the sidelining of minority leaders and women; (3) doctrinal rigidity / 'gatekeeping'; (4) racial microaggressions. It calls for a season of prayer between publication and Easter 2026. Total claimed signers: 224 (112 TEs, 42 REs, 65 Other Leadership, 5 Members). Spam attacks forced the signature form to be temporarily closed. Only the 13 initial Teaching Elders and 4 named Other Leadership/Member signers are exposed by the live signatories page.

notes: The pcaprayerandlament.com site explicitly lists 224 total signers (112 TEs, 42 REs, 65 Other Leadership, 5 Members) but the live signatories page only displays the 13 initial Teaching Elders plus 3 Other Leadership and 1 Member by name — the remaining ~207 signers appear to be aggregated as counts rather than published as a name-by-name list (possibly to protect signers from professional retaliation, possibly because of the spam-attack-forced form closure). I attempted to retrieve the full list via direct URL, /signatories, /signers, /full-list, /sign, archive.org, and several news write-ups — none expose the complete roster. Presbytery and church fields above marked 'likely' are inferences from each pastor's known public ministry and should be verified against the MOOP directory before being relied on. All 'unknown' fields should be filled in only via the MOOP directory match step. The Warhurst Hall of Infamy and this Letter of Lament are roughly opposite signals: Warhurst names PCA signers of the Statement on Social Justice / GRN-aligned anti-CRT protests; Lament names the soft-progressive / Kellerite / minority-leader contingent. Russ Whitfield is the strongest direct overlap point (AMR Executive Board AND Letter of Lament TE signer). Tim Keller is on the AMR advisory board; Duke Kwon and Irwyn Ince are the two highest-profile names on the Lament; Sean Michael Lucas is the highest-profile non-board AMR contributor; Alexander Jun (former GA Moderator) is the highest-profile RE on AMR's board.
